dashboard_notes.sync_delay_note: Exceed LMS and Challenge Lab credits can take up to 24 hours to appear on go/fde-enablement-dash. If missing after 24h, follow the re-enrollment steps in go/fde-dash-faq.

workstation.title: Workstation & Developer Toolchain
steps: Provision a high-spec Linux Cloudtop via go/mytech.
Configure Git and Piper workspaces for internal repos.
Set up local Python/uv environment, ADK, Jetski, and Antigravity CLI.

argolis.title: Argolis Personal GCP Sandbox
steps: Visit go/argolis as early as possible in Week 1.
Complete the 2 mandatory quizzes and 2 Qwiklabs.
Wait ~1 full business day for sandbox approval, then configure gcloud/ADC access.

github.title: FDE GitHub Organization Access
steps: Register your GitHub account at go/fde-github.
Request access to the cloud-ai-fde GitHub organization.
Verify SSH/2FA compliance with GTM GitHub guidelines.

rituals.title: Team Communication & Recurring Rituals
steps: Join core FDE Google Chat spaces (AI Tech GTM All, Global GenAI FDE chat) listed in go/fde-noogler-guide.
Subscribe to the team OOO calendar at go/fde-ooo-calendar.
Add recurring syncs: weekly FDE Community Learning Log and Friday Sub-Regional Triage.
Schedule intro 1:1s with your pod manager, onboarding buddy, and pod teammates.

items: Complete Workstation, Argolis sandbox, and go/fde-github setup.
Finish GEAP L200 (5 Days of AI + Exceed LMS Final Project Assessment).
Optionally knock out GAIL / CDL early certifications and start PCA prep.
Shadow pod teammates on customer calls.
Complete at least 6 of 7 GEAP L300 Challenge Labs (strict prerequisite for L400).
Attend in-person L400 Agent Building Bootcamp (build & present 2 agents).
Book FDE Consultancy Skills 2-day workshop and pass PCA certification.
Complete the 10-day FDE Capstone Project and Field-Readiness Panel Defense.
Join an active customer co-build engagement and deliver customer sprints.
Ensure all required enablement items (L200, L300, L400, PCA) show green on go/fde-enablement-dash.
Volunteer as a Capstone panelist for incoming FDE cohorts.
